text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm bored. Barely anything exciting
happened all
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa mutters to herself as
we're
headed back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nothing really revs her up more than
being in a
race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess every day can't be thrilling.
If that
were the case, you'd get too
accustomed to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Either way, there's got to be something
we can do
to spice up her day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The aquarium? Could there be a place
more
placid?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What, do you think something like a
dolphin show
is gonna get me going?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, is this the reason?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recently, I had picked up a flyer with
the title,
"No Way! Is That a Shark?!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That can't be. Like, you get to go in the
same
tank with them and everything?
choice_data_list: Apparently we can try feeding the animals.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I could see that if they were as big as a
whale,
but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Figures...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But sure. I'm bored and curious, so why
not?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There it is... Hey, wait a sec. There are
two
different events.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"No Way! Is That a Shark?!" and "Cutesy
Penguin
Racing."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right, then. Let's go see what the
sharks are all
about.
choice_data_list: Let's go with shark as planned!
When you say "race," I can't help but be curious...

text_block_list.name: Shark Mascot
text_block_list.text: And with my biiig mouth... I go CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shark Mascot
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone, this is what we call a
great white
shark. Have you ever seen
one before?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You said this event was about what
again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take out the flyer, below the bolded
title is
written—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Join the aquarium's all-ages event and
learn
about sea animals with Sammy the
Shark!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You don't need to apologize. It doesn't—

text_block_list.name: Shark Mascot
text_block_list.text:
And sharks swim really fast in the water!
Oh, you,
the Umamusume over there!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? You pointing to me?

text_block_list.name: Shark Mascot
text_block_list.text:
I have a shark hat here... Would you
mind wearing
this and chasing the kids
around a bit?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What? Why would I—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! An Umamusume shark is coming
after us!
Aaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shark Mascot
text_block_list.text:
We have a room prepared for them to
run around
in, and having an
Umamusume to chase them
would really
help keep the event exciting.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is the shark not gonna chase us?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey you little runts! You better start
runnin' if you
don't wanna get eaten up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she seems upset, Nakayama
Festa takes
the role seriously and
ensures the children enjoy
the event.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious? Sure, races are fun
but...
penguins?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Where's the aggression? Where's the
risk? I can
guarantee we'll walk out
disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So what?
choice_data_list: But a race is a race...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. This frickin' sucks. You'd better not

complain if I fall asleep halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaah! Go! You've got this! Kick it into
high
gear!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Penguin number three, Pen-Pen,
currently has the
lead! Following her is
penguin number five,
Gunther! Behind
them, Kin is trying to catch up!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
And did you know? Gentoo penguins are
said to
be able to swim at a maximum
speed of thirty-five
kilometers per hour!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thirty-five kilometers per hour under
water?!
Haha! These penguins are a lot
more than cute.
Who knew?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This is the most fun I've had all day!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sick... I didn't think they'd be racing
underwater.
That was way more exciting
than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Races really are the best. I only got a
keychain for
calling the winner, but it
sorta feels actually worth
something.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer. I saw the fire in your
eyes.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you had a good time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'd bet you're itching to run on the track
yourself,
actually.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The thrill I love is something you can
only feel
firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She laughs confidently, shooting me a
cocky grin
that practically screams, "And
you know it,
right?"
